verdict.rationale: Fenwick's own Startup Resource Center publishes a 'Top 10 Legal Issues for Startups' piece that tells founders to 'put appropriate equity vesting in place', plus an incorporation-stage issues overview, so founder vesting is covered in first-party materials. Coverage is thin: these are one-line form-page teasers, and the executive compensation page addresses employee equity plans rather than founder mechanics. Missing for 10: any documented coverage of 83(b) elections, any guidance on equity splits among co-founders, in-depth content on vesting schedule mechanics (cliffs, acceleration), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the resources' depth.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right

citations.quote: Put appropriate equity vesting in place, protect your intellectual property, comply with employment laws and other helpful tips.
Common issues startup founders face at incorporation, plus considerations and possible structures for seed financings.

Our startup resource center features articles, videos, checklists, presentations and other tools to help you navigate current challenges and anticipate upcoming issues at every stage of growth, from formation to scaling to preparing for exit.
